correctness.rationale: Writing \(m=2^ku\) with odd \(u\) and \(t=\nu_2(k+2)\) gives \(e(m)=2^{k+t}u((k+2)/2^t)\). Equality with \(2^\ell w\) forces \(k=\ell-t\), \(\nu_2(\ell+2-t)=t\), and the unique odd solution \(u=w/b_t\) exactly when \(b_t=(\ell+2-t)/2^t\mid w\). For unboundedness, telescoping \(a_{R+1}-a_j=2^{a_j}+2^{a_{j+1}}+\cdots\) makes the first term have uniquely minimal 2-adic valuation \(a_j\), so the constructed LCM target realizes every selected \(t\). A fresh exhaustive replay matched direct fibers for every target through 40000 and checked the first three branching constructions; the arbitrary-\(R\) proof is algebraic.
correctness.risk: The bounded replay is corroboration only and is not used to infer unboundedness.
